Class Container<T>

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A drawable which can have children added to it. Transformations applied to a container are also applied to its children. Additionally, containers support various effects, such as masking, edge effect, padding, and automatic sizing depending on their children.

AutoSizeAxes

Controls which osu.Framework.Graphics.Axes are automatically sized w.r.t. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.InternalChildren. Children's osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.BypassAutoSizeAxes are ignored for automatic sizing. Most notably, osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.RelativePositionAxes and osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.RelativeSizeAxes of children do not affect automatic sizing to avoid circular size dependencies. It is not allowed to manually set osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Size (or osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Width / osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Height) on any osu.Framework.Graphics.Axes which are automatically sized.

public Axes AutoSizeAxes { get; set; }

Property Value

Axes

AutoSizeDuration

The duration which automatic sizing should take. If zero, then it is instantaneous. Otherwise, this is equivalent to applying an automatic size via a resize transform.

public float AutoSizeDuration { get; set; }

BorderColour

Determines the color of the border controlled by osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.BorderThickness. Only has an effect when osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Masking is true.

public ColourInfo BorderColour { get; set; }

Property Value

ColourInfo

BorderThickness

Determines how thick of a border to draw around the inside of the masked region. Only has an effect when osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Masking is true. The border only is drawn on top of children using a sprite shader.

public float BorderThickness { get; set; }

Property Value

float

Remarks

Drawing borders is optimized heavily into our sprite shaders. As a consequence borders are only drawn correctly on top of quad-shaped children using our sprite shaders.

Content

The content of this container. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children and all methods that mutate osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children (e.g. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Add(`0) and osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Remove(`0,System.Boolean)) are forwarded to the content. By default a container's content is itself, in which case osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children refers to osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.InternalChildren. This property is useful for containers that require internal children that should not be exposed to the outside world, e.g. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.ScrollContainer`1.

protected virtual Container<T> Content { get; }

Property Value

Container<T>

CornerExponent

Determines how gentle the curve of the corner straightens. A value of 2 results in circular arcs, a value of 2.5 (default) results in something closer to apple's "continuous corner". Values between 2 and 10 result in varying degrees of "continuousness", where larger values are smoother. Values between 1 and 2 result in a "flatter" appearance than round corners. Values between 0 and 1 result in a concave, round corner as opposed to a convex round corner, where a value of 0.5 is a circular concave arc. Only has an effect when osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Masking is true and osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.CornerRadius is non-zero.

public float CornerExponent { get; set; }

Property Value

float
